cmd.description: 🎙️ Move the AI to this channel, or turn it off if it is already here (Admin only).

off: 🔴 AI is no longer listening in <#{channelId}>.
moved: It moved here from {channels} (one AI channel per server).
on: 🟢 AI is now actively listening in <#{channelId}>! All normal messages in this channel will get AI responses.{moved}
failed: ❌ Failed to update the AI channel.
